title: 第一卷 第5章 人如其名命里缺日第一卷 第6章 觉醒圣体生命的律动
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙
lines: 姜家主殿内，姜临天和一众族老彻底疯狂！
他们眼里没有半点私心，只有对姜家崛起的渴求！
甚至，脾气火爆的二长老，已经打算去抢亲了！
姜无痕见状，忍不住劝道：“家主，各位长老，咱们先冷静些……”
“那些个天之骄女，哪个不是各大势力的掌上明珠？若是同时向她们提出联姻，甚至去抢婚，无异于向各大势力宣战。我们姜家，或许会成为众矢之的……”
即便姜家作为不朽帝族，族内有大帝坐镇，也经不起这么折腾！
到时候，天之骄女没娶回来，先把人给得罪遍了，就得不偿失了！
“小无痕说的有道理，要不……先娶一个？”
有人提议道。
此话一出，顿时遭到了众人的反对。
“娶一个？让其他不朽世家看到，还以为我们姜家娶不起帝子妃呢！”
“娶十个，一天十个！”
“说得对！准备好聘礼，让所有势力知道，能够嫁给姜家帝子，是他们的荣幸！”
“安静！”
姜临天制止众人，淡然道：“诸位长老的心思，我能理解。但这种事，却不可太过激进。”
“就算姜家扛得住，无痕的身体也扛不住……”
他说这话的时候，众人不约而同的看了姜无痕一眼，眼神中满怀深意。
“家主，你的意思是……”
姜临战问道。
“封锁消息，今日在主殿内发生的一切，列为家族最高机密，任何人不得泄露！”姜临天神色凝重，吩咐道，“不仅要搜集阎浮大世界的天之骄女信息，姜家所辖下界各方中千世界、小千世界的天之骄女，也要尽快搜集。”
“我们要为无尘，从诸天万界……挑选最好的道侣！”
姜临天抬手搭在姜无痕的肩膀上，嘱咐道：“无痕，这些琐事你就不用管了，现在你要做的，就是调理好身体，为我们姜家开枝散叶！”
“我会为你准备最好的修炼资源，若有什么其他需要，也可随时来找我！”
姜临天目光灼灼，其他族老也纷纷点头，眼里满是情真意切。
姜无痕点头，心生感动。
家族这些长辈，对他的关心从未变过。
他离开姜家主殿，接下来要做的，只需要耐心等待。
这时，殿外两道身影迎了上来！
“帝子！”
姜凡、姜怜兄妹，不约而同的跪在了姜无痕面前。
“帝子对我兄妹二人恩同再造，今后我二人愿为帝子上刀山，下火海。但凡帝子有所需要，我们定当万死不辞！”
二人抬头，眼神中满是崇拜与狂热。
姜无痕见状，内心颇为欣慰。
两尊圣体！
都是好苗子！
若是好好培养，将来必定都是能够独当一面的强者。
同时，姜无痕下意识的用系统探查了姜怜一番——
【姜怜】
content_en:
In the main hall of the Jiang family, Jiang Lintian and all the clan elders were completely crazy!
There is no selfishness in their eyes, only the desire for the rise of the Jiang family!
In fact, the hot-tempered second elder has already planned to steal the bride!
Seeing this, Jiang Wuhen couldn't help but persuade: "Master, elders, let's calm down first..."
"Which of those proud daughters of heaven is not the apple of the eyes of all the major forces? If we propose marriage to them all at the same time, or even steal the marriage, it would be tantamount to declaring war on all the major forces. Our Jiang family may become the target of public criticism..."
Even if the Jiang family is an immortal imperial clan with a great emperor sitting in the clan, it cannot withstand such a torment!
When the time comes, if the proud daughter of heaven does not marry back, she will offend everyone first, and the gain will outweigh the loss!
"What Xiao Wuhen said makes sense, how about...marry someone first?"
Someone suggested.
As soon as these words came out, they were immediately opposed by everyone.
"Marry one? Let other immortal families see it and think that our Jiang family cannot afford to marry the emperor's concubine!"
"Marry ten, ten a day!"
"That's right! Prepare the betrothal gift and let all the forces know that it is their honor to marry the emperor's son of the Jiang family!"
"Quiet!"
Jiang Lintian stopped everyone and said calmly: "I can understand the thoughts of the elders. But this kind of thing should not be too radical."
"Even if the Jiang family can bear it, Wuhen's body can't..."
When he said this, everyone glanced at Jiang Wuhen in unison, with deep meaning in their eyes.
"Master, what do you mean..."
Jiang Linzhan asked.
"Seal the news. Everything that happened in the main hall today is classified as the top secret of the family. No one is allowed to leak it!" Jiang Lintian looked solemn and ordered, "Not only must we collect information on the proud daughters of heaven in the great world of Jamfu, but we must also collect information on the proud daughters of heaven in the various worlds under the jurisdiction of the Jiang family as soon as possible."
"We want to select the best Taoist companion from all over the world for Wuchen!"
Jiang Lintian raised his hand and put it on Jiang Wuhen's shoulder, and said: "Wuhen, you don't have to worry about these trivial matters. What you have to do now is to take good care of your body and flourish for our Jiang family!"
"I will prepare the best cultivation resources for you. If you need anything else, you can come to me at any time!"
Jiang Lintian's eyes were blazing, and other clan elders also nodded, their eyes full of sincerity.
Jiang Wuhen nodded, feeling moved.
The elders of the family have never changed their concern for him.
After he left the main hall of the Jiang family, all he had to do next was to wait patiently.
At this time, two figures came up to him outside the palace!
"Emperor's son!"
Brother and sister Jiang Fan and Jiang Lian kneeled in front of Jiang Wuhen in unison.
"The Emperor has shown kindness to my brother and sister. From now on, we are willing to go to the mountains of swords and the sea of fire for the Emperor. Whenever the Emperor needs us, we will fight to the death!"
The two raised their heads, their eyes full of admiration and enthusiasm.
Jiang Wuhen was quite pleased when he saw this.
Two holy bodies!
They are all good seeds!
If they are cultivated well, they will definitely be strong men who can stand alone in the future.
At the same time, Jiang Wuhen subconsciously used the system to explore Jiang Lian——
【Jiang Lian】
